decision: Selected the WGS84 point that the national classified-installations register (Géorisques installations_classees API) publishes for establishment AIOT 0007408791, EQUINIX France, 10 RUE WALDECK ROCHET, BATIMENT 520, 93300 Aubervilliers: longitude 2.36815, latitude 48.910175, copied without transformation, as the project locator.
operator_published_address: 10 rue Waldeck Rochet Bat 520, Building 520, 93300 Aubervilliers (Equinix PA6 page, Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026)
identity_bridge: The register names EQUINIX France at '10 RUE WALDECK ROCHET, BATIMENT 520, 93300 Aubervilliers', NAF 63, regime Autorisation, IED, 'En exploitation avec titre', with combustion heading 3110 (52.67 MW).

The DRIEAT inspection report of the 29 March 2023 visit (dated 17 April 2023, published on Géorisques for AIOT 0007408791) says EQUINIX FRANCE operates 'sur son site EQUINIX PA6 à Aubervilliers' a data centre consisting of one building with administrative, IT and technical parts, with 10 fuel-oil generators, authorised by prefectoral order of 20 August 2010.
Equinix's PA6 page (Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026) gives the same address, 10 rue Waldeck Rochet, Building 520, 93300 Aubervilliers.

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published longitude and latitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:2154 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's Lambert-93 coordinates (653687, 6867983) gives a point 0.035 m from the published one.

consistency_checks.cadastral_parcel: The IGN API Carto cadastre service queried with the register point (local local_data/country-research-equinix-emea-2-p13/ign-apicarto-parcel-at-icpe-point-pa6.json, sha256 2955987096d8...) returns the single parcel 930010000P0155 (section 0P, no. 0155, contenance 18,112 m2). With shapely 2.1.1 in Lambert-93 the point lies inside it, 41.4 m from its boundary and 40.2 m from its centroid (2.3682134, 48.9098163); the parcel's geodesic area is 18,114 m2 and its extent about 122 m by 185 m.
